<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex3052023-11-2489" status="finalized">
        <milestone unit="section" n="Post-colophon verses (84b1–84b3)"/>
         swa ti ḥ
         <milestone unit="section" n="1"/>
      <lg> <l>rgyal <choice><orig>yus</orig><reg>yum</reg></choice> sbus pa dum kun mchog gyur kyang || </l>
        <l> don rgyas tshig nyung shin tu rtogs bka' ste || </l>
       <l>  de don 'grel la dbang du gyur ba yi || </l>
        <l> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">rgyal sras bzang po</rs>s <lb n="84b2"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3709">rgyan gyi snang ba</rs> mdzad || </l></lg>

          <milestone unit="section" n="2"/>
        <lg> <l>des kyang mi gang la rjes 'jug gdul bya la || </l>
         <l>rgya bod 'dran <anchor xml:id="a7"/> zla bral ba'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3806">gro lung ba</rs>s ||</l> 
         <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4464"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3709">rgyan gyi snang ba</rs>'i rnam bshad </rs> phul byung mdzad ||</l>
         <l>'di la ma rten 'grel chen phyogs mthong med ||</l></lg> </seg></TEI>
source: 1_003_05 Gro_brgyad stong grel chen rnam bshad.xml
